name: @ledgerone/sync-client
description: 端无关同步客户端接线:apiFetch(401→refresh→单次重试)、auth 端点封装、同步去抖器。Web 与 App 的唯一实现,消除两端口径漂移(Review A1/P1-2)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
